paper_title: Discovering QCD-Coupled Axion Dark Matter with Polarization Haloscopes
suggested_experiment_name: Polarization Haloscope (ADMX-style cavity with nuclear spin polarization)
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis (canonical axion-photon coupling)
notes: This paper is a PROPOSAL/THEORY paper presenting projected sensitivities for a novel 'polarization haloscope' concept, NOT a measured exclusion limit. Figure 2 shows three projected sensitivity curves (100 L prototype, hyperpolarized cubic meter, post-discovery upgrade) but these are FUTURE projections, not current experimental results. The paper constrains the axion-photon coupling indirectly through the axion-gluon coupling (QCD axion), but the primary physics is the axion-induced nuclear EDM effect in polarized dielectrics. The y-axis of Fig. 2 is labeled '1/f_a (GeV^-1)', which is the inverse decay constant. To convert to g_agamma in GeV^-1, one would use the DFSZ relation g_agamma ≃ 0.87 × 10^-3 / f_a (stated in text), but since no actual measured data points are extracted from the figure (it shows only projected sensitivity bands), and the paper explicitly states these are 'projected sensitivity' curves for future experiments, no data_points can be reliably extracted. The local DM density ρ_DM ≃ 0.4 GeV/cm³ is stated in Eq. (3) and used throughout.
